test_cases.name: create_simple_tc_with_steps
test_cases.input: Create a new TC in the folder Experiment with title "This is a test case". Add 10 steps with a blank Req ID, Action "Action for Step #", Expected Result "Expecting Step # action completed" where # is the number of the step.
assertions: Creates new TC item with the given title
Sets field 7815 to a 10-element JSON array
Each step has empty ReqID, action containing "Action for Step N", expected containing "Expecting Step N action completed"

test_cases.name: add_description_and_setup
test_cases.input: Add a Description to TC-93: "This describes this test case with 10 steps". Add a Test Setup that says "This is the setup instructions".
assertions: Updates field 7798 with the description HTML
Updates field 7809 with the setup HTML

test_cases.name: direction_steps_with_files
test_cases.input: For directions 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 add steps where the action is a numbered list: Load the song named NG_dir_XXX_player_mV.hex for direction N; Analyze to acquire and process the data. Expected result: Summary view displays with corresponding direction bump and "8" segments. Also add the file list to Test Setup with the note "Transfer files to system with Player USB attached."
assertions: Each direction step has an <ol> action containing the exact filename
Expected result mentions the direction and "8" segments
Test Setup contains the transfer sentence and a <ul> of the eight filenames
